Name: Dark Interfaces (CP)
Author: certifiableGrimalkin
Description:
Stardew long needed a dark mode, and I've gotten tired of waiting to find one.
It's mostly just a vanilla interface, but darker.
Shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3644025]iHaku[/url] for making a dark mode mod that works. Based a lot of the idea on their mod.

The colour of the interface can be changed by config, or through GMCM (The options are: Grey, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple.). This only updates on game restart, save load, or new in-game day.

To change the font colour, check FixFontOption Installation, below. It is highly recommended. This only updates on game restart.

This mod has patch files for the following mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3379]Another Hunger Mod[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2007]Magic[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7831]ManaBar[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2536]Mod Update Menu[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10612]Moon Misadventures[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2545]Remote Fridge Storage[/url]

To apply the UI to these mods, look in the "COMPATIBILITY PATCHES" folder in this mod, under the colour of your choosing, and paste the insides of the corresponding mod's folder in the folder of the mod, to replace the image files. The files should be structured correctly, already. 


[size=5]FixFontOption Installation
[/size]
This mod technically doesn't require FixFontOption to function, but it is *strongly* recommended that you use it, otherwise most of the text in the game will be near unreadable. [url=https://blog.naver.com/khs3400/222049471897]Download FontFixOption here[/url] (scroll down to almost the very bottom of the blogpost, that's where the download button is).
Then copy one of the FixFontOption configs I provided in the "FFO CONFIG FILES" folder and replace the config in FixFontOption with mine, or place it in there, should there be none yet.
(Shoutouts to 진의 for creating that mod in the first place)
